note: SHRINK-ONLY. Pre-existing e2e selectors that bind to nothing in apps/reading/src. Do NOT add entries to make a red build green — a new unbound selector means a spec stopped testing what it claims to test. Removing an entry (because the selector was fixed or the spec retired) is expected and the lint requires it: a stale baseline entry reds with 'shrink the baseline'.
reconsider_if: This lint is static: it proves a selector NAMES something in the source, not that it is reachable at runtime. If the Playwright spec suite is ever wired into CI, this becomes a fast pre-filter rather than the only check, and the baseline should be re-derived against a real run.

provenance.why: WernerRig was deleted from main; this spec still locates [data-werner-rod]. No CI job runs the Playwright specs, so nothing went red. Being fixed in PR #3284 (mascot/dom-contract-rename) — when that lands, this entry must be removed.
